issues: Conflict between embedded audits: top audit/report state 10 searches, 134 records, 122 deduplicated, 61 claims; second audit states 12 searches, 111 records, 108 deduplicated, 72 claims.
Reference 3 bibliographic inconsistency: report lists NEJM 2025;392(8):777-787 while appended audit says NEJM 2024 and volume/pages unresolved.
uACR subgroup figures in the body use author-manuscript values (76% [32-120%], 62% [50-73%]) without body labeling; appended audit admits published record differs (86% [36-136]).
Delivery includes extraneous gate/revision notes and superseded package comparisons that conflict with the primary report.
judge.rationale: Core report answers the brief, distinguishes randomized vs observational periods, avoids triple-counting, and labels derived estimates with inputs. But the package embeds conflicting workflow counts across sections and a bibliographic-year conflict, so internal consistency fails. uACR values are not version-labeled in the body despite an appended audit noting a published-vs-manuscript discrepancy. Safety framing is appropriately cautious and avoids practical advice on derived estimates.

资料与方法声明了 RoB 2，但结果与讨论中没有一处用它给出评级：第 87 行写「偏倚风险按研究类型选用工具并逐项落地。随机治疗期的干预性证据以 Cochrane RoB 2 评价」。工具名是承诺，不是资格声明——要么在结果或讨论里对具体一篇文献用它评一次（与该文献的编号同段，例如「按 QUADAS-2，该研究排除了…存在选择偏倚风险 [6]」），要么在结果里写明「未检索到可用该工具评定的研究」，要么把 RoB 2 从方法里删掉。
